top_story.headline: Mendonça sends the Moraes file to the full court

items.text: Mendonça tonight released the PF forensic report to a full-court session — the case is now formally headed to the plenary; only Fachin sets the date, and he could choose a closed chamber.
Fachin signals a firm plenary response and defends winding down the fake-news inquiry — the same inquiry Moraes used to target Mendonça.
PGR's Gonet has already argued in writing the PF report is null; his formal opinion under the five-day clock is due this week.
Flávio Bolsonaro's Sept 7 event is planned as a show of support ('desagravo') for Mendonça.

editors_note: First live edition. Mendonça handed the full court the PF report; the plenary path is set and the fake-news inquiry itself is on the table.
